architecture_assessment.control_and_formula_preservation: Independently normalized import namespaces in all 24 vendored Python modules: 21 are AST-equivalent to upstream; only excel_async.py, excel_workbook.py and standalone_ir.py contain the reviewed narrow hooks. The original workbook, approved bridge and 12 existing tool sources retain their expected hashes. No control-law, CSV/Save algorithm or workbook-formula rewrite found.
architecture_assessment.workbook_and_default_selection: New instances select the authentic image-recovery workbook through fixed selection hooks; custom Excel/JSON paths and cells remain separate. Expected SHA is checked against the exact immutable bytes before bounded formula inspection. Preparation remains on the Excel owner worker. Missing/corrupt/unavailable built-in selection has no basic-algorithm fallback.
architecture_assessment.resource_lifecycle: Suite initiates IR close before waiting for busy work. The integrated view disables the time-based close escape and requires actual session/discovery/slice worker completion, drained chart events, verified Excel fence retirement and completed CSV plus both PNGs before destroying its host. Failure/cancel retains UI/data and allows a new close attempt with a fresh preference capture.
architecture_assessment.lease_and_test_mode: The exact standalone named mutex is acquired before explicit Connect, retained across disconnect and canceled close, and released on final host destruction. Test mode supplies inert discovery/lease/preference and a fail-fast offline runner; explicit fixture runners remain owned test code.
architecture_assessment.persistence: IR capture and restore bypass generic Tk reflection using a strict input allowlist. Runtime host/PID/session/recommendation/image authority is ignored. Restored image paths stay unanalysed with debounce canceled and active/pending state cleared. Missing central cap preserves the original preference; malformed central cap remains a visible invalid input rather than widening to 100.
architecture_assessment.namespace_and_packaging: Production imports remain isolated under ir_feedback with no flat aliases/sys.path mutation. Manifest-owned resources are staged with the expected relative scripts/DLL/JSON/template/workbook locations and explicit hidden package imports. The raw upstream test harness aliases exist only in its isolated test process.
architecture_assessment.presentation: Final wrapper/theme delta uses the shared palette/fonts and primary/danger buttons, namespaced IR metrics/status, concise mode notice and one suite toolbar title. It changes presentation only; final appearance and native font/layout assertions still require Windows execution.
